title: GameTranslation font manifest
description: Inventory of reusable fonts under .asset/fonts/. The repo ships only this schema and an example; the real manifest and the font binaries are local-only. Code and policies reference the logical `id`, never a filename or a machine path.

id.description: Logical id referenced by font policies and CLI flags (e.g. 'common-zh').

file.description: Filename relative to .asset/fonts/. Must not be an absolute path.

purpose.description: What this font is used for (e.g. 'unified zh/ja/latin UI font').

license.description: Distribution license. A font may only be embedded in a build when its license permits redistribution.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the font file; mismatch must fail doctor/bake.

coverage.description: Glyph coverage summary used by --font-policy auto checks.

covers_gb_simplified.description: True when GB simplified common Chinese is covered.
